select a.resource_id roomId,b.business_template_id, b.role_config from
cr_team_room a JOIN cr_team_template b on a.team_template_id=b.resource_id
cr_rb_room a JOIN cr_rb_template b on a.template_id=b.resource_id
WHERE a.resource_id = #{roomId}

select resource_id roomId,training_status from
cr_team_room
cr_rb_room
WHERE resource_id = #{roomId} limit 1

SELECT a.resource_id roomId,a.copyed_topo_id topoId,b.mp_scene_id sceneId FROM
cr_team_room a
cr_rb_room a
LEFT JOIN local_scene b ON a.local_scene_id=b.resource_id WHERE a.resource_id = #{roomId} limit 1
